notes.note: Edited: issuer field, binding requires issuer, issuer/endpoint pinned while bound, mismatch refused before secret read, empty scopes = advertised, scopes applied to registration. Checked against runtime.ts schema, tools.ts, mcp-service.ts and tool-server-oauth.ts. Other inputs: the API reference documents the declared issuer, empty scope choice and scoped registration; ToolOAuthClient adds the optional declared issuer; the integration schema accepts oauthClient.issuer (an RFC 8414 HTTPS issuer); mcp-service.ts refuses an issuer change while a client secret is bound, resets tokens on issuer change, and lets an empty sign-in scope choice drop the integration default.
